name: M7tawa Blog Radio – MP3 Library & Playlist Player
author: Ayman Abdullah

sections.description:
M7tawa Blog Radio – MP3 Library & Playlist Player adds a lightweight audio library player to WordPress.

Build one radio library from audio already stored in the WordPress Media Library, direct external audio file URLs, or audio files imported from a direct URL into your own Media Library.

Place the complete player anywhere using:

[m7tawa_radio]

The player automatically advances to the next track, so visitors can start the library once and continue listening without opening a separate player for every audio file.

Features include:

  • One shortcode for the complete audio library.
  • Play All with continuous next-track playback.
  • Add audio from the WordPress Media Library.
  • Add a direct HTTP or HTTPS audio file URL without copying the file.
  • Test a direct audio URL before adding it.
  • Import a supported direct audio file into the WordPress Media Library.
  • Drag-and-drop track ordering in the dashboard.
  • Previous, next, play, pause, volume, seek, shuffle, and repeat controls.
  • Optional visible playlist below the player.
  • Custom track title and artist or speaker fields.
  • Configurable default volume and accent color.
  • Responsive frontend player.
  • No third-party API or account required.

Remote servers may block external playback or downloads. A direct URL must remain available for externally hosted tracks. Imported files are played from the local WordPress Media Library after a successful import.

Browser autoplay policies may prevent audio from starting without a visitor interaction. The Play All button starts playback after the visitor chooses to listen.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP file from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Blog Radio in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Add audio from the Media Library or enter a direct audio file URL.
  5. Optionally import a direct audio file into your own Media Library.
  6. Arrange the tracks and save the settings.
  7. Add [m7tawa_radio] to a post, page, widget, or shortcode-compatible area.
sections.faq:
Does each track need a separate shortcode?

No. The single [m7tawa_radio] shortcode displays the complete saved library.

Can I use an audio file hosted on another website?

Yes. Add its direct HTTP or HTTPS audio file URL and keep it as an external track. The remote server must allow the browser to access the audio file.

Can I copy a remote audio file into my WordPress Media Library?

Yes. Use Import to Media Library. WordPress downloads the supported audio file and creates a normal Media Library attachment on your site.

Does playback continue to the next track automatically?

Yes. When a track finishes, the player moves to the next track in the current library order.

Can I change the track order?

Yes. Drag tracks in the Blog Radio settings page and save the settings.

Does the plugin stream a live radio station?

No. The plugin is designed for audio files and direct audio file URLs, not live radio streaming services.

Does the plugin require an external service?

No. The plugin does not require a third-party API or account. External audio URLs are accessed only when the site owner chooses to add or import them.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Align the plugin text domain and package directory with the WordPress.org assigned plugin slug.

1.1.1

  • Added Edit source controls for saved external audio tracks.
  • Added direct URL editing and testing without removing the track.
  • Added one-click conversion of an existing external track into a local Media Library attachment.
  • Preserved the track title, artist, position, and frontend player behavior when changing its source.

1.1.0

  • Added direct external audio URL support.
  • Added direct audio testing from the settings page.
  • Added an option to use a remote audio URL without importing it.
  • Added secure importing of supported direct audio files into the WordPress Media Library.
  • Preserved Media Library tracks, preview controls, shortcode copying, and the existing frontend player behavior.

1.0.1

  • Added a one-click shortcode copy button with visible Copied confirmation.
  • Added direct audio preview controls to tracks in the admin library.
  • Added a clear success notice after radio settings are saved.
  • Removed the translation placeholder pattern that triggered Plugin Check’s MissingTranslatorsComment error.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added a single shortcode for the complete audio library.
  • Added continuous playback, shuffle, repeat, seek, and volume controls.
  • Added Media Library selection and drag-and-drop ordering.
  • Added player appearance and playlist display settings.
